notes: VARIANT for fleet 1d107ed (lastswing-01 NOT promoted): fixes-bundle ecf33b6 = 1d107ed + digsync + stale-stop + craft-advice + hive-progress; prereq-usable is NOT in it (it is built on last-swing). THE FIXES BUNDLE (owner 09-29 evening: 'bundle the small fixes'). Members, each built, reviewed by both engines and tested on its own: (1) digsync -- ghost blocks: a server-refused dig is rolled back and player_loaded is sent (proved on the sandbox: 3 ghosts -> 0); (2) stale-stop -- a pathfinder stop flag no longer kills the next walk (13,275 pickup drops retired unreached in 6 h); (3) craft-advice -- a surface bot is told cobblestone, not cobbled_deepslate (42% of craft rows), torch never 'charcoal' (LOW IMPACT by both reviews; correctness only); (4) hive-progress -- a hive bot's milestone progress survives a restart in its own slot. Clean merge, 207/207, sandbox smoke (gather logs + cobble, deposit, no errors). A REVERT names its member (each line is tagged); that member is dropped and the rest rerun. EXPOSURE is the AGGREGATE (fixesbundleread): ready only when digsync, stalestop and craftadvice can each be judged -- no member passes vacuously.

licence.note: The baseline has no digsync module and no `_dig_sync`/`_dig_rollback` row kinds. Every canary bot writes a heartbeat every 10 minutes and on disconnect, so rows are certain within the first read.
